purpose: Canonical reopen-condition registry for incomplete Accounting Spine instruments. It prevents repeated source probing or synthetic completion after a scientifically frozen identification boundary. An instrument reopens only when new evidence matches its declared trigger or an explicit contract revision is scientifically justified.

F2.frozen_boundary: F2M is materialized, but F21/total F2 remain incomplete because the Direct-Investment F2 currency-and-deposits subinstrument needed for the exact BPM6-to-ESA bridge is not disseminated.
F2.reopen_when: A source with definitionally comparable Direct-Investment F2 subinstrument detail or an equivalent exact ESA/BPM6 bridge becomes available.
evidence_that_does_not_reopen: broad Direct-Investment debt instruments (FA__D__FL)
the residual gap between known functional components and QSA total F2
historical proportions or allocation shares
missing-value-to-zero assumptions

For the stock BNR boundary, an official BNR/financial-accounts counterpart source for the 6.1 million RON asset stock, or a separately justified structural-zero adjudication, is required.
evidence_that_does_not_reopen: zero aggregate BNR transactions used as bilateral flow zeros
allocation of the 6.1 million RON BNR asset row by shares
conditional BNR-zero stock cells promoted as unconditional
a fresh live QSA response that reproduces the same coefficient topology
